# SeQUeNCe extensions summary (diff-driven)

Upstream ref (local): upstream-master
Merge base: 5600eb7971df06a66b06a1b7418513599a3d0f58

What changed vs upstream (short list):
- Added transduction-aware strategy parameters (BK/DQT/EQT) with eta and eta^2 scaling in core simulator paths.
- Added entanglement-service availability simulator, request logging/normalization, and deadline-based success metrics.
- Added batch runners for eta-threshold, upgrade-k, and topology sweeps with reproducible aggregation.
- Added diagnostics (served rate, miss-deadline rate, slack, completion time) to explain eta-insensitivity.
- Added analysis/plotting scripts to generate thesis-ready figures and tables.
- Added supporting data assets, tests, and docs to validate and describe the workflow.
